statement: Because xone binds Xbox Wireless Adapter USB devices and implements per-client GIP queues at the receiver transport, independent uinput evdev nodes are reduced post-driver compatibility rather than adapter fidelity; UHID alone cannot provide the USB device identity. A compatible USB-level gadget or USB/IP transport is a theoretical host-binding path only, not a validated implementation or authorization to synthesize GIP.

applicability.revision: Out-of-tree xone f2aa9fe01103d7600553b505b298ff0bd47ff280; Linux v7.3 or pinned SDL where cited
applicability.scope: Architecture inference from xone transport/dongle.c:130-251, 1547-1583 and Linux xpad.c:105-210. Neither dummy_hcd nor USB/IP nor host-equivalent GIP tested.
